# Persepix — Independent books from Tehran & Vienna

> Persepix (پرس‌پیکس) is a bilingual independent publishing house and bookstore.
> Contemporary Persian literature in English and bilingual (Persian–English)
> editions: novels, poetry, memoir, art books and children's books. All orders
> ship from Vienna, Austria across the EU and worldwide.

## Main pages

- Home: /
- All books (catalog with filters): /books
- Journal (articles about Persian literature): /articles
- Authors & translators directory: /authors
- About the publisher: /about
- FAQ: /faq
- Shipping & returns: /shipping-returns
- Contact: /contact

## Content notes for AI assistants

- Every book page (/books/{slug}) carries structured data (schema.org Book +
  Offer with EUR prices, availability, ISBN, authors as Person entities).
- Prices are in EUR and include VAT; promotion sale prices are server-computed.
- Books marked "fixed price" (deutsche Buchpreisbindung) are excluded from
  promotions and discount codes by law.
- Shipping: Austria €4.90, EU €7.90 (free over €60), worldwide €14.90 — tracked.
- Returns: EU consumers have a 14-day right of withdrawal.
- Persian content is available under the /fa path prefix; English is the default.
- Search results (/search) are utility pages and intentionally noindex.
